name: halftone-background
title: Halftone Background
description: A halftone print on a canvas: a rotated screen of dots sized by the ink a lit sphere takes, with a light that circles it or follows the cursor.

props.name: angle
props.description: Screen angle in degrees; 45 is the classic print angle.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the light circles the sphere. 0 holds it still.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Let the light follow the cursor. Off on touch screens and under reduced motion.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
